Sister Philomena Kharakor 


La pynkyntang riewniam Va i Sister Philomena Assilian Kharakor rndm 
ha ka seng Ki Sister ka Maria ki Mishon (Sisters of Our Lady of the Missions) 
ha u snem 1968. 

La kha Va i ha shnong Laitlyngkot ha u 'Nailur 8, 1 947. 1 long i khun I balai 
jong i Bah Gregory Shrone Shabong bad i Kong Victoria Brian Kharakor 
(baroh arngut bam kwah ha Ving u Blei). Baroh shi-iing ki la wan sha ka 
Balang Katholik na ka Balang Presbyterian ha u snem 1953. 

I la pule la ka klass'A' ha Laitlyngkot ha u snem 1952. Hynrei, namar ki 
daw khynnah ba i tieng la u nonghikai, im shym treh leit skul shuh ha 
shnong. Oonbok ba ha ka jingsaihdur u BleL ka lad thymmai ka piie Va i. 
Da ka jingaijingmut jong u Ph Eusebius Usai, uba trei ha Parish 
Laitumkhrah, la pynrung skul Primary Va i Sister ha St, Mary's ha u snem 
1954. Tang hapdeng shisnem ki nonghikai ki la pynkiewar-klas Va I, na Klas 
B sha Klas II. 

I Ju long banyngkong barabor. la ka Jingkheih, I ju Voh belt 100 na ka 
100 bad i don ka bor kynmaw kaba phylla. I stet bha ban Vohbat Va ki 
jinghikai. i la Voh Va ka baibam (scholarship) na ka eksamin Klass III & Klas 
VI. Nangta ha Klas Vlll, ha u snem 1961, ka klas kaba Vakynduh lang ki 
khynnah skul Khasi bad khynnah skul Phareng, kam shym la pynjemdaw Va

i. I Sister i bat beit Va ki jaka ba shakhmat, i ju laknieh ban Voh banyngkong 
ne ba-ar. Kumta sa shisien ki Sister ki la pynkiew ar-klas Va i na Klas Vlll sha 
Klas X. 

Ynda lait matrik ha u snem 1963, i khlem lelt kolej, hynrei i la Valeh 
shuwa da ka Teachers'Training jong ka Assam. Ta kane ka klas ruh i la long 
ka banyngkongduh. Kane ka jingpyntbit ka aibor Va i ban pynVaid Va ki skul 
ME. 

Hadien ka training riewniam, kum ka private candidate, i la pyndep la 
ka ka Pre-University na Gauhati University ha u senm 1970. 

Ryngkat bad ka lyngkor pynVaid skul, i Sister i la Vakhun Va ka BA kum ka 
private candidate bad pass with Distinction na ka Gauhati University 
(1973), Ha u snem 1974, i la pass Va ka BT First Class na ka Skulbah 
North-Eastern Hill University (NEHU). KIba Voh First Class ha kane ka 
kynhun banyngkong jong ka NEHUkI la Voh national scholarship ban leit 
pule ha kano kano ka University kaba ki mon. Ka jingkhia kam ka la 
khanglad Va I ban pdiang Va kane ka khusnam, I la hun ban pyndep Va baroh 
ki degree da kaba trei artat artat.

Ka Shatwaidong 


Ka Kolshor Khasi kumba ka Paw ha ka Literashor (1930-40) 
ka la paw pyrthei ha u snem 1988. Ka la dei ka por ban sngap la 
ki nongpule kiba dawa, ba dei ban pynmih biang sa shisien la ka. 
Khublci shikhohtyndaw la phi bamh ki paidpiile. Hynrei na ki daw 
bym lah kiar, ki lynnong ki sah hi kumjuh kum ha ka sienshon 
banyngkong. Ka jingkwah ban shon noh wut wut ban loh pyndonkam 
ki paidpule ka la pynkhapbrip la ki khmat bad pynset kyllut la ki sur 
pasiaw ba dei ban tynsat symboh pyrkhat thymmai. 

Dei na kitei ki daw ba ha kane ka sienshon ba-ar, lait noh na 
ka riikom pynsnoh dak, ym shem iohlad ban pynwandur wandar 
th>mmai. Ka jinglynga jongnga ban lohnoh Va ka mkom spel bad 
rukoni pynsnoh dak ka la ktik ban tih, wad bad sngapthuh Va ka 
rukoin kren jong ka jaitbynriew. Khlam pep ki don bun ki 
paranongthoh nongpule kiba don kajuh ka jingthrang. pynban, na ki

daw ba baroh baroh ngi Va-ap jingong eli, ym shem don banud ban 
sdang. Hooid ka Khasi Authors' Society ka la wer la ki nongthoh 
ban lamih lasyllok lang ha ka 30 tarik u Naiwieng, 2006. Ha kane

hap pep dorbar.

Ka Lamphrang 


Ka lynter bad ka pyngkiang jong ka kolshor ka don u thning 
bad u jyntang uba sub thied shaduh ka hyndai. Ka jaitbynriew

kaba panpoh la lade da ka kolshor u iongshuwa ka don ka hok 
ban im shong pi ah shong siiang bad ban im junom katba kane 
ka pyrthei ka dang kynoi la ki khun bynriew. 

Ka jingdkut mynsiem shiteng ryta jong ki kolshor bakhraw 
ka pyrthei ka sakhi la kane. Balei kirn don shuh mynta, ka long 
ba ka pateng bynriew kaba lohpateng la ki. kam shym khein kor 
la ka hyndai ne ka mynnor kaba la seng la dang la ka longkolshor 
mankolshor jong ki. 

Kumba paw ha ka histoii. ka don tang kawei ka jaitbynriew 
kaba la lah ban khie khlieh na ki jingshah tangon bad jingshah 
sangoh jong ka lyngba ki juk kolshor bapher bapher. Kata ka 
jaitbynriew ka dei ka Israel. 

Ka mynsiein ba eh rang jong ka Israel ka shong rieh ha 
ka jingtip jong ka ia ka histori la jong, uwei pa uwei u Ju, u 
tip lut shaphang la ki Iongshuwa manshuwa pateng pateng. Ka 
Israel ka la sdang la kane ka rukom hikai pateng la U longdien 
naduh ka snem ba ka la shah ring mraw sha Babilon. Mynta ka 
Babilon ka la shu sah syrngiew tang ha ka paki-kulong (museum), 
katba ka Israel pat ka dang ring mynsiem lyngba ki khun ki ksiew 
ba im. 

Ka tnat kolshor jong ka anthropology ka dang shemphang 
shaphang ka dor jong ka kolshor dang shen, dang tang kumba 
arspah snem eiei. Ha kita ki arspah snem ki ri ka Yurop ki )a 
sdang pyntrei kam ban hikai la la ki longdien ha ki skul pule jong 
ki i'a ka histori la jong. Ki sa sdang pynrung Ya kiwei pat ki histori 
ynda kita ki khynnah pule ki la kham eh-ning ka jiitgitiut 
jingpyrkhat, ynda ki la seng jingieid Ya la ka ri bad Ya la ka 
kolshor. 

Ka jaitbynriew Khast kaba la don la ka jong ka non^nmom 
kolshor ka la im lyngba bun tylli ki spah snem Yia ka tyn^gt

ki kpa tymmen bad ki kni tymmen, hynrei ha ka por ba kiwei 
ki ri ki la sdang sngewthuh la ka dor jong ka kolshor. La wan 
kiew' u Phareng sha ki lum Khasi ban pynVar hima dohlieh, ryngkal 
bad kita ki nongpynVar hima, la wan ruh ki mishoneri kiba la wan 
seng skul ban hikai pule hikai thoh la ki khynnah Khasi. Dei ha 
kane ka por ba ka ri ka la jan phasi Valade da u tyllai kolshor 
nongwci. Ki khynnah skul, ki la kham tip shaphang kiwei pat ki 
ri bad kiwei pat ki kolshor, khlem da seng nongrim shuwa la 
ka rympei la jong. Shipor, ynda kita ki khynnah ki la khie samla 
bad ki la rangbah, ki la pynpaw ka mynsiem ingkhong shyllangmat. 
ban peit beih ia la ka kolshor bad ban tynneng la ka Jong kiwei.

Ka rynieng rynhiot Jong u Soso Tham kam duna la ka rynieng 
jong ki radbah anthropologist ka ri lurop, kiba la shemphang 
shaphang ka Jylli Jong ka kolshor. Ki ktien shong sbai Jong u ki 
sakhi la kata ka Jingshemphang bajylliew Jong u : ‘‘Kum u khyllung 
uba ring bor ring mynsiem haduh ban da san na ka shadem ka 
kmie bad u sumar kylliang la ka, ngi ruh ngin .suh thied sha la

kolshor ki la prat. 

Ka Kolshor Khasi kumba ka paw ha ka Litlrlshor Khasi 
( 1930 - 40 ) 

Ngin lap ia ka kolshor Khasi ha ka niam ka rukom, ha ki 
riti ki dustur, ha ki symboh jingngeit, ki symboh balatynsat ha 
ki puriskam bad ki khanatang ha ka synshar ka khadar, ha ka 
dustur kheih kur kheih kha, ha ka trei ka ktah, na ka shad ka 
kmen, ka riam ka beit. ha ka ktien ka thylliej, bad kumta ter ter. 

Ka Jingieid ri Jingieid kolshor jong ki rangbah Khasi ka la 
sdang kyrsei naduh ki snem kiba khatduh jong ka spah snem kaba 
khatkhyndai. Ki rangbah kiba la sngewthuh i'a ka jingkordor 
Jong ka jaitbynriew bad ka kolshor la jong ki la sdang pynmih

ki jynthoh katba ki kot ei la ka bor. Kita ki rangkynih raagphawar, 
kum ki jong u Jcebon Roy, u Rabon Sing bad kiwei ki la kham 
nob sha ka niam Khasi, hadien habud sa mih sa ki poitri kiba 
dei hi shaphang ka niam bad ka akor Khasi. Hynrei ki poitri bad 
ki jynthoh kiba kham tai la ka kolshor ki mih ha ka phew snem 
ba la Jcr da u R.S. Lyngdoh, kum ka Juk khie rasong Jong ka 
litercshor (1930-40). Ha kine ki shiphew snem, ngi loh la ki jynthoh 
ba sahnam sah burom jong u Soso Tham, u H. Elias, u H. Lyngdoh, 
u David Roy bad jong ki bym dei Khasi ruh kum u G Costa, 
u Keith Cantlie bad u J. Bacchiarello. 

Ka llieng jong ka kolshor, kumba la pyni nia sha khmat ka 
long kaba Yar haduh katta katta. Kumta kane ka M. Phil, disser- 
tation ka ktah tang katto katne lylli ki phang, dang bun ki phang

kiba dang sah shrah, kiba dang ap ia kiwei pat ki nongtih bad 
nongwad. 

Ki phang ha la ktaid hangne ki ktah ia ka Jaitbynriew : ha 
ka jingkheih kur jingkheiYi kha, ha ka rukom synshar rukom khadar, 
ha ka dustur lohpateng, ka niam ka rukom, ka shad ka kmen 
bad ki jinglong jong ka Kolshor lyngba ki juk bapher bapher jong 
ka. 

Na ka Hang ka litereshor ka dissertation ka thmu ban shim 
la ki drama, ki poitri bad ki jynthoh pious (prose) kiba mih ha 
ki shiphew snem ba la jied.
